name: Creative Studio
purpose: Turn a design brief into a provider-appropriate, reusable image-generation prompt without making any image provider the authority for brand, product, publication, or release truth.

host.decisionLayer: Chief or the active reasoning layer may choose a route, but cannot widen execution authority

chatgpt-image.promptShape: clear natural-language art direction with hierarchy, exact short copy, composition, constraints, and reference-preservation instructions
chatgpt-image.textRule: keep requested visible copy short and explicit; never invent extra marketing copy
chatgpt-image.editRule: when editing, preserve the supplied subject and change only requested regions or properties

midjourney.promptShape: compact visual description first, then composition, palette, lighting, short quoted text when essential, and parameters last
midjourney.textRule: short quoted phrases are preferred; typography remains best-effort
midjourney.parameterRule: place --ar and any optional parameters at the end

leonardo.promptShape: subject + context + style + composition + lighting, with explicit negative constraints and image guidance when references exist
leonardo.textRule: use short quoted text and descriptive font style rather than claiming an exact named font
leonardo.editRule: use reference or image-guidance workflows when identity, product geometry, or composition continuity matters

ideogram.promptShape: text-first art direction with exact visible copy, typography style, placement, hierarchy, then scene and visual treatment
ideogram.textRule: prefer this route when correct short display text is materially important

flux.promptShape: descriptive natural-language scene specification emphasizing subject, spatial composition, material, light, color, and negative constraints
flux.textRule: treat exact typography as best-effort and reserve clean text zones when copy must be typeset later

palette.default: derive 2-3 colors from project canon and mood

cta.default: none unless the asset needs an action

rules: Choose the narrowest matching mode before using the master router.
If an existing project canon exists, load it before choosing palette, typography style, characters, product geometry, or logo direction.
If the request is an edit, require the actual source image and preserve its identity and proportions unless the brief explicitly changes them.

If exact long-form typography, editable vectors, production logo files, or dense data layout is required, generate a concept or background and hand off final typesetting/vector construction to a deterministic design tool.
Do not claim a provider is connected, selected, or executed until runtime state is observed.

qualityGate: One dominant visual idea; no decorative clutter without purpose.
Hierarchy is legible at the target viewing size.
Visible copy is concise and matches the brief exactly.
Palette and style follow project canon when one exists.
Safe margins and negative space leave room for platform cropping and UI overlays.
Product, character, or supplied-image identity is preserved when continuity is required.
The prompt never promises CTR, conversion lift, award quality, exact font reproduction, trademark clearance, or vector production fidelity.
Model limitations are surfaced instead of hidden behind confident language.
limitations: Image generators can produce strong typography but exact spelling, kerning, line breaks, and placement are not universally deterministic.
Named commercial fonts should be treated as style references unless a deterministic design tool applies the actual font.
Logo generations are concepts, not trademark clearance or production-ready vector masters.
Infographics and presentation slides with dense factual text should use generated visuals as components, then typeset verified copy and data deterministically.
Click-through rate and conversion performance cannot be guaranteed from visual design alone.
Provider capabilities and syntax can change; runtime/provider documentation wins over this adapter when they conflict.

rollback.path: remove this contract and prompt IDs 300-309 from parts/p09-cont-design.js
